automation.name: Daily Read-Only Report
automation.description: Example TSAL R0 automation that reads data and produces a local report without external mutation.

goal.outcome: Produce a daily summary from an authoritative data source.
goal.success_condition: The report accurately reflects the source data for the declared period.
goal.correct_non_execution: Do not produce a report when the source is unavailable or the requested period cannot be determined.

work_item.selection_rule: Select the current completed reporting period.

risk.rationale: The automation is read-only with respect to external systems.

authority.revocation_mechanism: disable the invoking process or schedule

policy.description: Produce at most one report for a completed period.

state.write_safety: Only local generated report files may be written.

ambiguity.on_unknown: Stop and surface the inability to establish source truth.

dispatch.strategy: bounded retry for transient read failures

scheduler_reevaluation.condition: A later scheduled run may reevaluate a reporting period when source availability is restored.

backlog.stale_definition: A reporting period is stale after the next period begins.

verification.preflight: Verify source readability and period selection.
verification.dry_run: Render report to stdout or a temporary file.
verification.postcondition: Confirm the output identifies the correct reporting period.
verification.runtime_health: Confirm source remains readable and no unexpected mutation path exists.
verification.evidence: Store command result and report metadata.

recovery.procedure: Repair source/configuration, rerun preflight, then regenerate the report.
recovery.resume_gate: Preflight passes with an unambiguous reporting period.
